blocks.content: Place a microwave safe container of water into the cavity and close the oven door.

blocks.section: Diagnostic view
blocks.content: Select a magnetron to test operation and display the current draw at maximum output. This will time-out after 30 seconds (the cooling fan will automatically run during the test).

blocks.content: Individual magnetron test:

blocks.section: Individual magnetron test:
blocks.content: If during the magnetron test the displayed current is 0 A and the E101 error occurs, then the failure can be found in the 230V circuit. Refer to the schematics to find the fault for repair (IO Board, connections, HV primary winding).

blocks.section: Individual magnetron test:
blocks.content: If during the magnetron test a low current draw is seen (around 3A) and the E101 error occurs, then the failure can be found in the high voltage circuit. Isolate the power supply and test the high voltage components (HV transformer, diode, capacitor, magnetron and connections) to find the fault for repair. Never measure the high voltage circuit live. See "Replacing components" within section 6 of this manual.

blocks.content: Select the heater. The heating element runs for 5 minutes. Selecting the heater again will turn it off. The convection fan automatically runs by default (the fan speed can be manually altered up to 100%).
